title: Install and configure infrastructure dependencies
description: Install all required npm packages for the infrastructure layer: Drizzle ORM, better-sqlite3, Express, Crawlee, concurrently, tsx, and their TypeScript types. This sets up the foundation that all other tasks depend on.
acceptanceCriteria: All packages listed in steps install without errors
TypeScript does not report missing type errors for installed packages
Package.json devDependencies and dependencies are updated correctly

steps.description: Install Drizzle ORM and SQLite driver
steps.details: Run: `npm install drizzle-orm better-sqlite3` and `npm install -D drizzle-kit @types/better-sqlite3`
Run: `npm install crawlee`. This installs CheerioCrawler and all Crawlee dependencies.

steps.description: Install concurrently and tsx for running multiple processes
steps.details: Run: `npm install -D concurrently tsx`. concurrently runs Next.js + Express in parallel. tsx enables running TypeScript files directly with `tsx src/scraper/server.ts`.

steps.description: Install Vercel AI SDK and Anthropic provider
steps.details: Run: `npm install ai @ai-sdk/anthropic`. This installs the unified AI SDK with `generateObject`, `generateText`, `streamText` and the Anthropic Claude provider.
Run: `npm install zod`. Zod is used for all AI SDK schema validation via generateObject.
Run `npm install` to ensure clean install. Check that node_modules contains drizzle-orm, better-sqlite3, express, crawlee, concurrently, tsx, ai, @ai-sdk/anthropic, resend, and zod folders.

technicalNotes: The project is already scaffolded with Next.js 16.1.6, Tailwind 4.2.1, Vitest, and Playwright — do not reinstall or reconfigure those.
better-sqlite3 requires native bindings — it compiles on install. Node.js >= 22 is required.
crawlee may take a while to install due to its dependencies (got-scraping, fingerprint-injector, etc.)
